summary: Iteration 7 - Ask Bata + Help Center. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (help endpoint auth + 11 sections incl. validation with 12 items, suggestions=8, sessions CRUD with owner isolation and cross-user 404, empty-text 400, SSE stream returns error event with 'Universal LLM Key balance is exhausted' followed by done - user message NOT persisted and title stays 'New conversation', existing 'Which partners are behind...' session verified (user+assistant with tools[0].name=='run_report'), insights nl_query.status=='active', regression dashboard/reports/target_vs_actual all 200). Frontend: admin & mgmt logins verified. Sidebar shows nav-ask-bata (2nd) and nav-help-center (last). Floating ask-fab visible on Dashboard. Drawer opens with ask-chat-panel, ask-input, ask-send-btn, ask-drawer-close, ask-drawer-expand - shows 4 compact suggestions. Expand navigates to /ask. Session list contains the existing 'Which partners...' session; clicking it renders ask-user-message + ask-assistant-message with 2 markdown tables and 1 ask-tool-chip that expands (innerHTML 6703 -> 15147). New conversation clears to ask-empty-state with 8 suggestions. Sending 'How is Achievement % calculated?' shows the friendly 'The Universal LLM Key balance is exhausted...' inline as data-testid='ask-error'; input re-enabled; app does not crash. /help shows 11 TOC entries in the exact expected order; searching 'achievement' produces 4 results and help-item-f-achievement visible; deep link /help#f-achievement scrolls and applies help-flash class. Dashboard KPI cards and chart titles all expose help-link-d-sales/target/acceptance/pending/weekly/partner/dq/category/top-skus. Clicking help-link-d-target navigates to /help#d-target (KpiCard's onClick to /reports is correctly stopped via HelpLink stopPropagation). Reports page shows help-link-reports and per-report help-link-r-<key>; switching to report-target_vs_actual updates it to help-link-r-target_vs_actual. Insights shows nl-query-link (href=/ask) and old nl-query-stub is gone. mgmt role has both Ask Bata and Help Center in nav and can access /ask and /help.

minor.issue: message_count counter can drift from actual messages: existing seeded session reports message_count=8 while chat_messages collection has only 2 documents. Counter is $inc'd by 2 per successful turn but is not decremented when messages/session are otherwise manipulated. Not user-visible today, but a self-heal (compute from collection) would be more robust.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/ask.py send(): if streaming throws before any TextDelta or tool result, the user message is deleted but the session's message_count could still have been incremented by a previous try; consider derived counts.

Ask.jsx: clicking 'New conversation' does NOT delete the just-created empty session from the sidebar (title 'New conversation' persists after an exhausted-key attempt). Minor UX — a hidden empty session accumulates per failed attempt.
ChatPanel.jsx: no visible loading/streaming affordance while waiting for the first SSE event; consider a subtle indicator during streaming=true when msgs are pending.
Reports.jsx line 46 & 74: extremely long JSX lines (>1000 chars) — hurts maintainability; consider splitting.
